description: DNS lookup and domain health check: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, CAA and SOA records asked of the source, SPF and DMARC email policy parsed, and the HTTPS certificate verified like a browser (issuer, names, expiry, days left, TLS version). Flags missing SPF or DMARC, duplicate SPF and certificates near expiry. Input: domain (a URL is accepted). $0.05 per call.
name: hubvibe_domain_dns
title: Domain DNS, email security and TLS certificate
